name: portfolio
description: Themeable full-stack portfolio (Angular UI themes + NestJS API + MongoDB + Admin)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,ui,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/ui-default" "npm run dev -w apps/admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/ui-default && npm run build -w apps/admin
